answer:
The mother of Joseph Smith Jr., the person who claimed to find the sacred writings that became the Book of Mormon, was **Lucy Mack Smith**. 

Joseph Smith reported that he received the Golden Plates from angel Moroni in 1823 near Palmyra, New York. These plates were translated by him between 1827 and 1829, resulting in the publication of the Book of Mormon in 1830. His mother, Lucy Mack Smith (née Lucia Hickson), was born around 1775 and died in 1856. She was a significant figure in early Mormon history and was an active participant in the church after its founding.
